item.title: US presses Meta to submit AI models for federal review
item.description: The Trump administration is pressing Meta to join other major US AI developers in voluntary federal model reviews, signaling rising scrutiny of frontier-model security risks.

item.title: ByteDance unveils Seedance 2.5 video model
item.description: Seedance 2.5 can generate 30-second video clips from a single prompt and is slated for China availability, keeping ByteDance in the front tier of AI video competition.

item.title: Mistral releases OCR 4 for document intelligence
item.description: Mistral OCR 4 targets state-of-the-art document understanding with enterprise deployment options, including containerized use and integration into search and structured-data workflows.

item.title: Anthropic introduces Claude Tag for Slack workflows
item.description: Claude Tag lets enterprise and team users assign Slack-based tasks to Claude, connect it to tools and codebases, and retain context across channels.

item.title: OpenAI starts rolling out Bidirectional Voice Mode
item.description: OpenAI has begun rolling out a ChatGPT voice mode powered by Bidi 1 that can speak while listening and be interrupted, pointing to more natural real-time AI assistants.

item.title: NVIDIA and AWS add Blackwell GPUs for production AI inference
item.description: NVIDIA and AWS are bringing RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell GPUs to EC2 G7 instances, promising up to 4.6x AI inference performance for production workloads.

item.title: NSA Anthropic talks highlight frontier AI cybersecurity use
item.description: NSA analysts reportedly tested Anthropic tools that quickly identified flaws in classified-network trials, while a broader classified AI contract remains unresolved.

item.title: SpaceX signs up to $6.3B AI compute deal with Reflection AI
item.description: SpaceX reportedly agreed to provide Reflection AI access to Project Colossus and Nvidia GB300 capacity, underscoring the scale and value of frontier-model compute infrastructure.

item.title: OpenAI updates GPT-5.5-Cyber and launches defensive security tools
item.description: OpenAI launched an updated Codex Security plugin and Daybreak defensive cyber stack, positioning GPT-5.5 for controlled use in security operations.

item.title: Alibaba HappyHorse 1.1 rises near the top of AI video rankings
item.description: Alibaba's HappyHorse 1.1 video model reportedly moved to No. 2 in global rankings and is live on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, signaling a competitive shift in AI video generation.

item.title: John Jumper leaves Google DeepMind for Anthropic
item.description: AlphaFold co-lead and Nobel laureate John Jumper is reportedly joining Anthropic, a major frontier-lab talent move from Google DeepMind.

item.title: Inception Labs releases Mercury 2 diffusion language model
item.description: Mercury 2 is a cloud/API reasoning language model using diffusion-style generation at roughly 1,000 tokens per second, highlighting continued exploration beyond transformer-only serving.

item.title: Sakana launches Fugu multi-agent orchestration model
item.description: Sakana Fugu presents multiple expert models behind one OpenAI-compatible API, delegating selection, verification, and synthesis as a single orchestration layer.

item.title: Noam Shazeer leaves Google to join OpenAI
item.description: Noam Shazeer, a key Google AI researcher and Transformer coauthor, is reportedly moving to OpenAI in a notable frontier-lab talent shift.

item.title: Vercel releases eve open-source agent framework
item.description: Vercel introduced eve, an open-source framework for production AI agents with durable execution, sandboxed compute, approvals, subagents, and evaluations.

item.title: ChatGPT market share slips below 50%
item.description: ChatGPT reportedly fell below half of AI assistant market share for the first time as users increasingly switch among Gemini, Claude, Grok, and other assistants.

item.title: DeepSeek becomes China’s most valuable AI startup after $7.4B raise
item.description: DeepSeek reportedly raised more than $7.4 billion in a financing round, underscoring the scale of China’s frontier-AI funding race.

item.title: Android 17 expands AI agent integration
item.description: Android 17 adds AI-focused capabilities and discoverable tools for on-device agents, pushing agent integration deeper into the mobile operating system.

item.title: Cursor Origin targets agent-native software development
item.description: Cursor Origin is a Git-compatible forge designed for many AI agents cloning, branching, committing, rebasing, reviewing, and fixing failures in parallel.

item.title: NVIDIA Blackwell dominates MLPerf Training 6.0
item.description: NVIDIA’s Blackwell platform led MLPerf Training 6.0 results, highlighting faster and larger-scale training performance for frontier AI infrastructure.

item.title: SpaceX to acquire Cursor in $60B stock deal
item.description: SpaceX is reportedly acquiring Cursor for $60 billion in stock, a major consolidation move around AI coding tools and agentic software development.

item.title: Sakana releases Marlin autonomous AI researcher
item.description: Sakana released Marlin, an autonomous researcher that plans investigations and generates detailed strategy reports, signaling continued progress toward agentic research workflows.

item.title: Factory launches Factory 2.0 software-factory platform
item.description: Factory described its move from coding agents toward software factories for autonomous planning and execution across software-development workflows.

item.title: LMSYS details DFlash v2 speculative decoding
item.description: LMSYS detailed a new generation of speculative decoding that reports throughput gains over baseline inference and native MTP speculation.

item.title: Z.ai releases GLM-5.2 flagship model
item.description: Z.ai made GLM-5.2 available to GLM users as its new flagship model, with API and chatbot access expected to follow.

item.title: Moonshot releases Kimi K2.7 Code for agentic coding
item.description: Kimi K2.7 Code is a coding-focused agentic model with a 1T-parameter mixture-of-experts architecture and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API access.

item.title: US government forces Anthropic to disable Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for foreign nationals
item.description: Anthropic says a US export-control directive forced it to abruptly suspend Fable 5 and Mythos 5 access for foreign nationals worldwide, creating a major precedent for government control over frontier-model access.

item.title: OpenAI to acquire Ona for long-running agents
item.description: OpenAI announced an acquisition aimed at secure cloud execution for long-running agent workflows.

item.title: Anthropic backtracks on opaque frontier-model safeguard rerouting
item.description: Anthropic said it will make frontier-model safeguards more transparent after researchers found requests could be silently routed to a lesser model.

item.title: Xiaomi releases MiMo Code agentic coding harness
item.description: Xiaomi's open-source terminal-native coding assistant claims strong performance on ultra-long 200+ step software tasks.

item.title: EU orders Meta to open WhatsApp to rival AI chatbots
item.description: EU regulators ordered Meta to stop blocking rival AI assistants from the WhatsApp Business API.

item.title: Google introduces DiffusionGemma for faster text generation
item.description: DiffusionGemma is a 26B mixture-of-experts text diffusion model targeting lower latency and up to 4x faster generation on GPUs.

item.title: OpenAI weighs Nvidia-backed 10 GW Ohio data-center lease
item.description: A reported 10 GW campus lease would be a major signal of frontier-AI infrastructure demand and compute scaling.

item.title: Dario Amodei publishes AI-exponential policy agenda
item.description: Anthropic's CEO argued for faster AI policy work, including mandatory testing and stronger security standards.
